items.fact: Commitment/technical grade disagrees across three fields (II vs I-II vs III)
items.prior_evidence: Still split: the two sources that grade this route disagree (III and I-II), and the row already holds both values in different fields, so no single value can be kept by the rule. One route database grades the Sitkum Glacier Grade III (matching alpine_grade); the long-standing route site gives Grade I-II (matching commitment). The rule keeps the row's own value when a source supports it, but here each conflicting value is held by the row and supported by one source, so there is no basis to pick one; grade 'Grade II' sits inside the I-II range.
